English: Hermits Hut
A simple, makeshift shelter for a wandering holy hermit, providing a spiritual anchor for the clan in the wilds.
Stone Cell
A rough stone cell for ascetic prayer, offering a more permanent retreat for holy men and increasing the clans spiritual cohesion.
Scriptorium
A humble tent or wagon for copying holy texts and recording clan chronicles, subtly improving unity and prestige.
Prayer Chamber
A dedicated wooden structure for communal prayers, fostering greater unity and favor with the clergy.
Cloister Pavilion
A tented cloister forming a spiritual heart for the clan, its organization improving unity and clan sentiment.
Monks Hall
A wooden hall where monks gather for learning and prayer, strengthening the clans spiritual bond and reputation.
Refectorium
A communal dining tent where monks and visitors gather, promoting hospitality and further clan unity.
Abbey Room
A private chamber for the abbot or senior monk, symbolizing the clans spiritual leadership and enhancing prestige with the Church.
Choir Chamber
A dedicated chamber for sacred music and song, drawing pilgrims and increasing the clans religious prestige.
Grand Monastery
A grand, stone-built monastery, a beacon of faith on the steppe, inspiring unity, piety, and the respect of all Christian realms.
